scope: Independent code, input-only metadata and generated pure-AST review of fixed100 public Pallox initializer intake. No source RGB/P3 feature array, weight tensor or file body, model construction/forward, GT cues/masks/pose, current223, fit or PnP read/run by reviewer.

checks.name: Native queries and L
checks.result: First score argmax/first tie; original raw9/all candidate data retained; native0..7 unshifted; centroid8 excluded only from q8/L. V60 AST L and no-detection8 preserved.

checks.name: Bounds
checks.result: 240 generated geometries/1920 native slots plus no-detection8: exact continuous [0,W), nearest floor(q+.5), equivalent RGB96 centre [-.5,W-.5) separately named; original q/L match V1 exactly.

checks.name: Affine
checks.result: Frozen canvas_affine derived by code-only AST, four independent scalar fixtures agree. Run explicitly checks exact gain+offset against each V90 record and exports them. Prior bounded metadata audit found all100 records consistent; no repeat full metadata audit.

checks.name: Runtime and data parity guards
checks.result: Approved input-only entry and protocol/code/input/asset hashes precede source model construction. Declared Torch2.1.1cu118/CV2.4.9.0 checked, deterministic FP32/TF32-off flags explicit. Decoder raw bytes/HW/decoded RGB SHA, shapes/pad/affine, cached FP16 P3 exact equality, first-source repeat, warmed state and checkpoint SHA are required before complete seal.

checks.name: Output scope
checks.result: All100 original frame metadata rows and all800 native query occurrences retained, including no detection/OOB. Existing V90 P3 bindings reused only after exact fresh comparison. Native semantic state UNKNOWN/human gold false/training admission false. No GT-based instance association, query repair or label generation path.

checks.name: Side effects and chronology
checks.result: No source run at import; only run stage imports source ML modules. Generated stage uses NumPy/AST only. Existing output directory fails closed; failure receipt and no auto-retry preserved. Root must supply a new approved entry for any actual source execution.

limitations: This PASS is preparation review, not a completed forward/parity certificate. Actual all100 decoded/P3/affine/state/call checks remain producer obligations after root entry.
Original confidence-selected detector target can be wrong or unrelated; this intake does not associate any cue with a target or establish native expected-part visibility.
Source is the same previously exposed one physical bin and lab/hall partition, not an independent capture-family generalization proof.
Declared interpreter path is enforced by the root launch contract; runner itself verifies Torch/CV2 version rather than sys.executable.

Protocol output byte budget is declarative; the 100-frame metadata output is bounded by actual candidate serialization, without a hard code-level byte counter. This does not change model/query choice.
